newsitem.title: UK: CSFB cuts FTSE 100 mid-year forecast to 4,200.
newsitem.headline: CSFB cuts FTSE 100 mid-year forecast to 4,200.

text.p: Strategists at Credit Suisse First Boston cut their mid-year forecast for the FTSE 100 index on Wednesday to 4,200 from 4,425 amid concerns over U.S. interest rates.

European equity strategist David Aserkoff said he expected the U.S. Federal Reserve to tighten credit again up to four times in the near future, raising the Fed funds rate to just above 6 percent over the next six months.
"We are telling investors that we expect a flat to negative second quarter in most European equity markets," Aserkoff said. "Given what we have seen from the Fed at the end of last month."
Aserkoff said he was advising clients to take profits and raise cash levels.
"If you take profits now and invest in bonds," he said "Even after yesterday's shocking losses, you will still end the year in positive territory."
"The balance of risk lies in the negative, at least in the short-term."
